exposure: American College of Surgeons minimum criteria for full trauma team activation (ACS-6)
cohort: The study included 20,872 consecutive patients over 15 years of age from an urban Level I trauma center, observed between 1993 and 2006.
finding: Adding Shock Index (SI) thresholds to the American College of Surgeons minimum criteria for full trauma team activation increased sensitivity for emergency operative or procedural intervention, but with a larger decrease in specificity.
